name: Somali National Theatre
subtitle: An open-air theatre described by press as Chinese-built.

facts.label: Builder
facts.value: Described as Chinese-built (opening year 1967 not confirmed in a read source)

facts.label: Closure
facts.value: Closed in early 1990s with civil war

facts.label: 2020 refurbishment
facts.value: Reopened June 2020, funded by businesses, chamber of commerce and civilian workers

parts.text: An open-air theatre described by press as Chinese-built. It closed in the early 1990s and has reopened for concerts since 2012.
